question: When was the Treaty of Purandar signed between Jai Singh I, commander of the Mughal Empire, and Shivaji?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1665.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Treaty of Purandar:-**

 
 
• It​ was signed between **Jai Singh I, commander of the Mughal Empire, and Shivaji **in **1665.**
 
• The treaty was signed after** Shivaji's defeat** in the **Battle of Purandar**, and it resulted in **Shivaji surrendering 23 forts** to the Mughal Empire.
 
• The treaty allowed Shivaji to **keep his remaining forts **and retain his title of **"Raja,"** but he had to acknowledge **Mughal suzerainty** and pay a tribute of **400,000 rupees.**
 
• The treaty was a significant turning point in** Shivaji's career** as it marked his** first formal agreement **with the Mughal Empire and established a **fragile peace** between the two powers for several years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 1639 predates Shivaji's rise to power and the emergence of the Maratha Empire.
